items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: So one good thing about it was I became, I would become friends with Yusef Lateef, with Elvin Jones, with Paul Chambers, people like that that would be there occasionally.

ctx.x: Yeah. Can you describe for us what that was like? What would the tunes be? And was the function of it partly to meet people, to maybe find gigs and just improve yourself?

No. The function of it, mind you I’m the young guy. I’m just there you know. I’m out of the exterior if you will. The function of it was to touch base. The musicians that would gather there each and every Sunday that might be in town or might be at home, but just meet and have a good time playing music. So what? It wasn’t about having a gig or anything like that. Because as I mentioned before on the way to New York, now that I’m out of the Army where I practiced my bass every night until three or four in the…
Did you join the military or were you drafted?

items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: until a gig came, a concert came with — who was I with, that was with Yusef Lateef.

ctx.x: No. To be blunt about it, to this day I’ve been very fortunate to maintain what gives me reason to relate to my students about how to maintain in terms of being prepared for the event on the stage. I preach occupation to so speak. I mean survival insofar as economics are the ability to maintain financially on the stage as one who has just entered the world of performance, I try to prepare one to be at a level of respect that would create a possibility of finding employment or continuous activity, whatever. But…

bills had fallen out of my pocket. I had no savings, no nothing. That’s when it hit me. Because there were no performances in the near future. So I went through a bit, about three months of uncertainty. After about a couple of weeks I began borrowing from friends to get a little of this and that. And then after about a month there was no, I mean nobody would support me. Even my best friends. So I struggled for about two months without anything, just, I don’t know how I did that but I had no money at all until a…
